pages.title: Silken Liver Slipper
pages.text: Race 4: Seattle, 4.6 miles, the home town of grunge. Password: AIRPORT. Skitchin' (EA, 1994), Mega Drive / Genesis. Music by Jeff van Dyck.

pages.title: Grunge
pages.text: Grunge was not the plan: the graffiti artists, visiting EA Canada, suggested it. Jeff had written few rock songs, so he shut himself in with a pile of Seattle grunge CDs.

pages.title: Rave reviews
pages.text: GamePro gave the game 19.5 out of 20 and praised its 16-track soundtrack of 'mind-blowing heavy metal'. Australia's Hyper gave 89% and liked how the music, the graffiti and the spray-can art hang together.
